detail: The column is headed 'Effect size' with no named convention. Rank-biserial (W+ - W-)/(n(n+1)/2) and matched-pairs r = Z/sqrt(n) were each computed from the printed V; neither reproduces the printed values. title: Table 9 dataset and denominator
detail: Table 9 does not name the dataset(s) behind the evasion rates, nor the denominator (all fraud, or fraud detected before the edit). The repository's robustness scorer takes both from the supplied benchmark file and reports them.

title: Supplementary S1 cost arithmetic
detail: Unit costs inferred from sums/counts are constant within each dataset; total loss and savings = 1 - total/(P x c_FN) reproduce every row. Inferred (c_FN, c_FP, c_TP-review): {'D1': (300.0, 5.0, 5.0), 'D2': (25000.0, 5.0, 5.0), 'D3': (150.0, 5.0, 5.0)}.

title: Supplementary S2 gaps and ECE deltas
detail: Recomputed from the printed columns. All agree.

title: Supplementary S4a n_cal on D1 vs the described split
detail: The conformal calibration set is the second half of the chronological VALIDATION segment, which is the last 10% of the training months (Table 1). D1 has 1,000,000 rows in total, so that half is at most 50,000 rows; S4a prints n_cal=100,000. Either n_cal was drawn differently from the described protocol or the split description is incomplete.

title: Equation 5 is typeset incorrectly
detail: As printed, 'reject' is assigned to P < T_high and the escalate branch reads T_low <= P >= T_high. Section 3.8.1 gives the intended rule (below T_low accept; above T_high reject; both endpoints in the review band). This repository implements the Section 3.8.1 rule.

title: LoRA learning rate typeset as '2 x 10^4'
detail: Section 3.3.1 prints 2 x 10^4 (a typesetting loss); Section 3.8.1 prints 0.0002. This repository uses 2e-4.

title: Feature counts
detail: Table 1/2 state 30 input features for D1 after excluding fraud_bool and protected attributes; the raw BAF base file has 30 features plus the label and month, so excluding the protected attribute leaves 29. The realised count is reported by `vrfraudnet data check`, never padded.

title: Wilcoxon statistic missing for one baseline
detail: Table 6 prints '-' for V of logistic regression (the maximum 465 is implied by p = 9.31e-10 = 2^-30).
